items.text: Ha kiro eky'amakumi abiri na bbina eby'okwezi kunu, abantu ba Isirairi bakasorrokana basiiba kandi bajwara eguniya,
Abaisirairi bakeebaganiza ha banyamahanga bayesesira itaka omu mutwe baayemerra baayetonda habw'ebibi byabo na habw'obubi bwa baisenkurubo.
Bakeemerra omu kiikaro kyabo; baasoma ekitabu kya MUKAMA Ruhanga okumara ekicweka ekya kana eky'ekiro; ekicweka ekya kana ekindi, baakimara nibeetonda, nibaramya MUKAMA Ruhanga wabo.
Ha matembero g'Abaleevi, hakeemerraaho: Yeswa, Bbaani, Kadimyeri, Sebbaniya, Bbuuni, Serebbiya, Bbaani na Karani; baateerra MUKAMA Ruhanga wabo omuranga.

Nubwo Abaleevi: Yeswa, Kadimyeri, Bbaani, Hasabbuneya, Seribbiya, Hodiya, Sebania na Pasahiya baagambire bati: “Mwimuke muhaisanize MUKAMA Ruhanga wanyu ebiro byona. Ibara lye ery'ekitiinisa eritaina mutaano omu kusiimwa n'omu kunyumizibwa, likugizibwe.”

“Kandi Ezira akagamba ati: Iwe wenka, niiwe MUKAMA; niiwe wahangire iguru, iguru erinyakuli hara muno, na byona ebinyakurumu, ensi na byona ebinyakugiroho, amayanja na byona ebinyakugarumu; kandi ebi byona niiwe obirinda; byona eby'omwiguru bikuramya.
Niiwe MUKAMA Ruhanga, ayakomere Abburahamu wamwiha omunsi Uuri ey'Abakalidaaya, wamuruka ibara Abburahamu;

Okarora nkooku ali mwesigwa hali iwe, nukwo kumuraganiza kuha abaijukuru be ensi ey'Abakanaani, Abahiiti, Abamooli, Abapeereezi, Abayebbusi, n'ey'Abagirigasi; kandi eki waraganiize okakihikiriza, habwokuba oli muhikiriire.
“Okarora omuhito ogwa baisenkuruitwe obu bakaba bali omunsi Misiri, kandi wahurra omuranga baakuteeriire ha Nyanja Erukutukura,

okakora ebyamahano n'ebihuniriza omumaiso ga Faraaho, abaheereza be n'ag'abantu ab'ensi ye boona, habwokuba okamanya nkooku baakozire kubi baisenkuruitwe; okeetungira ekitiinisa eki oinakyo okuhika na hati.
Okatemera abantu bawe omuhanda wabambura nibarubata hoomere, abakaba babakurasire, okabadikya omu nziha, nk'ibaale oku lidikira omu maizi agahamire.
Omu bwire bwa nyamusana, wabeebembezaaga enyomyo ey'ekicu, kandi ekiro obeebembeza ey'omurro kubamulikira n'okubooleka omuhanda ogu baraatoma.
Niiwe wasirimukire ha rusozi Sinai, wabaza na bo nooyema omwiguru, wabateeraho Ebiragiro eby'amazima, wabagambira ebigambo eby'obulyo,
niiwe wabamanyisize Sabbato yawe erukwera ey'ekitiinisa? Wabaragira ebiragiro, wabagambira ebigambo ebi warabize hali Musa omwiru wawe.

“Enjara obu ekaba ebali kubi, niiwe wabahaire ebyokulya ebyarugire omwiguru, obu baakwasirwe iroho, niiwe wabaihiire amaizi omu mwandara, kandi niiwe wabaragiire kugenda kulya ensi ei okaba orahiire ngu oligibaha.
“Baitu bbo na baisenkuruitwe, bakeebbanaaza baaba ngumangani;

baayanga kuhurra, bataijuke ebyamahano ebi wakozire hagati yabo; baitu bakagumangana, baayekomera omwebembezi ow'okubagarra Misiri omu Bunyagwa. Baitu niiwe Ruhanga anyakwikara ayeteekaniize kuganyira, ow'embabazi kandi ow'engonzi, atarahuka kubiihirwa ow'engonzi ezitagarukirra, otabanagaije.
Noobu baayekoliire enyana ei baayagize omu bintu, baagamba ngu: ‘Ogu nuwe Ruhanga wanyu ayabaihire Misiri,’ baajuma muno bati iwe Ruhanga,
habw'embabazi zawe ezitagambwa, otabaleke omwirungu; ekicu rundi omurro ekyabeebeemberaga nyamusana n'ekiro kubooleka omuhanda otabibaiheho.
Okabaha Mwoyo wawe omurungi abeegese, otabaime byokulya kandi okabaha amaizi ag'okunywa.
Okabakwatirra omwirungu okumara emyaka amakumi ana, bataina ekibabuzireho; ebyokujwara byabo bitakule, kandi batazimbe maguru.
Okabaha amakama n'amahanga, okabaha ensonda zoona; nukwo kulya ensi eya Sihooni omukama wa Bbasani.
Okakanyisa baijukuru baabo, baingana enyunyuuzi ez'iguru kandi okabaleeta omunsi ei wagambiire baisebo ngu baligitaahamu bagirye.

Na baijukuru baabo nukwo kutaaha omunsi egi bakagirya, abasi b'ensi egi, nubo Abanyakanaani, okabajemura nabo nibarora wababata omu ngaro, hamu n'abakama baabo, n'abantu ab'ensi egi, babakole nkooku barukwenda.

Bakahamba embuga ezizitiriirwe n'ensi enguuda, baakwata amaju aganyakwijwire ebintu ebirungi byona, agalimirwemu amaziba, embuga ezinyakurumu engonjo ez'emizabbibbu n'ez'emizaituuni, n'emiti enyakwana ebijuma etarukubarwa; habweki bakalya, baiguta, banyeeta, baayegondeza omu bintu ebirungi byona ebi wabahaire.

“Baitu noobu wabakoliire ebi byona batakuhurre kandi bakakujeemera, ebiragiro byawe bakabinaga enyuma, baita abarangi bawe abaabahaburaga ngu: Bakukubukire bakakora n'ebindi bingi eby'okujuma Rahanga.

Nikyo wabalekiire abanyanzigwa baabo bababonese, obu bakaba nibabonabonesibwa, bakakuterra omuranga, okeema omu iguru wabahurra; habw'embabazi zawe ezitagambwa okabaha abajuni abaabajunire abanyanzigwa baabo.
Bakarumisa kutunga obusinge, baagaruka baakusiisira, naiwe wabalekera abanyanzigwa baabo baabalema. Baitu obu bayegarukamuga, noyema omuiguru, bakakusaba kubajuna, wabahurraga.

Okabahabura bahondere ebiragiro byawe, kyonka bbo bakagira emyehembo tibahurra ebiragiro byona ebi; omuntu owalibihondera alyomeera omubyo, kandi bakakuteera amabega, baagumya engoto yabo bayanga kuhurra.
Baitu okabagumisiriza emyaka nyingi, wabahabura na Mwoyo wawe noraba omu barangi, baitu nabwo batahurre. Nahabweki okabaleka omu mikono yabantu b'amahanga.
Baitu nabwo, omumbabazi zawe enyingi muno, atabamaleho n'obu akubaire kubanagaija; habwokuba oba munyambabazi kandi Ruhanga omuganyizi.

“Nahabweki hati, Ruhanga waitu, owobusobozi kandi owamaani, owokutiinwa anyakulinda endagaano kandi ow'engonzi ezitayuga; okutalibana kunu okutwiziire, hali abakama baitu, ababiito baitu, abanyakatagara baitu, abarangi baitu, abaisiitwe, n'abantu bawe bona kurugirakimu omubwire bw'abakama b'Asiriya n'okuhika hati, kutakusisanira nk'okuke.
Baitu iwe oikaire ohikiriire omubyona ebyatugweriire kandi okakora n'amazima baitu itwe twakora kubi;
abakama baitu, ababiito baitu, abanyakatagara baitu n'abaisiitwe tibahondera ebiragiro byawe n'obwakubaire kuhuliriza ebi orukuragira, hamu n'okuhabura oku obahereza.
Batakuhereze omu bukama bwawe n'omuburungi bwawe obwingi obuwabahaire, n'omunsi enkooto kandi ey'omweru eyi wataire omu maiso gaabo; nabwo batahinduke kuleka engeso zaabu embi.
Dora itwe tuli bairu na kiro kinu, omunsi eyi wahaire baisenkuruitwe balyeege ebijuma n'omweru gwamwo, dora tuli bairu.
N'ebirungi bingi ebigirugamu bitwarwa abakama abawatuteireho kutulema habw'ebibi byaitu. Baina obusobozi ha mibiri yaitu nahante zaitu nkooku barukwegondeza kandi tuli omu mwetunturo mukooto.”
Habweki byona nitukora endagaano etarukuyuga, nitugihandiika kandi ababiito baitu, Abaleviiti baitu n'abanyakatagara baitu bagiteho emanyikirizo.
